description: Get full details of a specific boat: security deposit, cancellation policy, amenities, fees, seasonal prices, check-in/out times, location details — and the dates it is actually free (priced date ranges plus bookable slots for the year ahead). Use when the user asks about a specific boat, and whenever a boat came back in `named_matches` and they want to know when it IS available. With dates, `stay_price` states Due now, Paid at pickup and Total first, then the charter, its discounts and the deposits.

currency.description: Optional: the currency every amount in the answer is written in, and any price you send is read in. EUR when omitted.

date_from.description: Optional check-in date YYYY-MM-DD of the stay you are quoting. With date_to, `fees` are the ones that apply to that stay, and `url` opens the boat on those dates when the stay is one we sell — `stay_price` prices it and, on a boat with no check-in periods, it starts and ends on the boat changeover day. Pass both whenever you quote a price for specific dates.

date_to.description: Optional check-out date YYYY-MM-DD — see date_from.

guests.description: Optional: the party the stay is priced for; without it, the boat's capacity.

id.description: Boat id from search_boats results (including named_matches) — copy it verbatim.
